newsitem.title: FRANCE: France admits Lagardere, Alcatel bids on Thomson.
newsitem.headline: France admits Lagardere, Alcatel bids on Thomson.

text.p: The French government said on Friday that Britain's General Electric Co Plc (GEC) was not eligible to bid for defence electronics firm Thomson-CSF .
It said it had received offers from Lagardere Groupe and a joint bid from Alcatel Alsthom and Dassault Industrie in the Thomson-CSF privatisation, the finance ministry said in a statement.
It said GEC's bid could not be considered as the sale of more than 50 percent of Thomson-CSF to a foreign firm was contrary to national security interests.
The government encouraged the eligible candidates to set out their plans for French and European industrial partnerships when they submit final offers for Thomson-CSF, the ministry said.
The government said it hoped the privatisation would provide the opportunity for a restructuring of the French and European defence electronics industry.
The government is privatising Thomson-CSF as part of a consolidation of the fragmented French defence industry and has said it also wants to involve European firms in the sale.
Firm and final offers are due by May 7 and the government hopes to make a decision by the end of June.
